title: Maria B
content: My grandmother had recently died. I had strangely felt the need to go to church for her. I went to pray on the day of her death and the following days. One night, I found myself catapulted into a tunnel made of concentric circles with a gray background. From each of the circles, emanated an immensely warm and loving light. It was very white but not blinding. In this dream, I was spirit and eyes. I was also fused with the spirit of my grandmother; it was as if we were intimately arm in arm. At the end of the tunnel the circle became very small. I knew that the road in the tunnel was very long and far away from us. In the center of that small circle was an individual waiting for me. I saw a stylized man-like shape. He was gray in color but transparent. I accompanied her on her journey and we knew that he was waiting for us. I knew that it was not Jesus, but was like an assistant. He waved and moved while waiting for our arrival. Time did not exist there. Even the space was different; we walked and never moved forward. We had been there for a long time; but it was as if time never passed. It seemed like an eternal moment as if time did not pass. at every step there were some kind of chimes, and I heard wonderful music they seemed like angels to me. I was perfectly aware of what was happening in the dream; that is, I was accompanying my grandmother for a little while on her journey. I knew everything I was experiencing and I didn't ask myself questions. Then I woke up. If I had to summarize my experience with just one word I would say 'LOVE.' It was an experience of indescribable love. I felt peace, serenity, relaxation, and comfort. But above all, I felt love. It was a different love that was not even comparable to maternal love. This love is not describable with earthly words. I was in a dimension of peace and love.

elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, It was as if time had no value, as if it did not exist.

elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, My grandmother was with me.

elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, A very bright white light was everywhere but not blinding.

elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, love towards everything and everyone
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, A being was waiting for us at the end of the tunnel. I knew it was waiting for us.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain, I was aware of being in the afterlife
Yes, During the experience, I felt absolute love.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I understood the futility of earthly matters. We have little time on this earth to do beautiful things, to reach love and unite with the universe
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Uncertain, After many years when I reached spiritual maturity
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, I can't explain with earthly words what belongs to a different dimension. I try to describe the concept of different love, but on earth, there is a sterile environment. Inside, there can be a ray of love that binds you bilaterally to something or someone. Yet, imagine you are in a room. At a certain point, your son enters and you feel a ray of love that binds you to him and unites you. While there love, it is not a feeling towards someone. But there, it is all love; the air itself is love. I was lowered into a dimension of love. It had a dense energy as if it were a thick fog; it is as if I were lowered into a tub of love in which everything is fused and everything is love.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I remember every detail because this experience deeply touched my heart. I remember the emotions. When I'm feeling down, I close my eyes and try to recall that immense love
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I discovered I have the ability to connect with something in the afterlife
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I think I understood the meaning of life - that love is the meaning of life.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, It was as real as I know I am writing now
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, It's all real because I felt it with my heart
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes, After my father's death, I felt the same love again when I connected with his soul
